desktop_dial_wake_sent: Body of the wake wait on the desktop shells. host: the host's name.
desktop_dial_waking_unnamed: Headline while a host with no known name wakes.
desktop_hosts_added_click: Toast after adding a host on the desktop. host: its name or address.
desktop_hosts_preset_hint: Under the preset picker in the edit-host sheet. “Connect with” names the card menu's item; keep it the same as that item.
desktop_link_unpaired_host: A link named a host this device has not paired with. host: its name or address.
desktop_pair_arm_title: Title of the box that says where the PIN comes from.
desktop_pair_paired_connecting: Toast after pairing when a connect follows at once.
desktop_pair_waiting_for_host: Headline while a request for access waits. host: the host's name.
desktop_profile_save_failed: The profile pick was not written to disk. reason: the file error, English.
desktop_trust_saved_failed: The stream runs but the host's certificate pin was not written. reason: the file error, English.
desktop_trust_trusted_toast: Toast after the first stream to a trusted host. fingerprint: the first 16 hex digits.
desktop_menu_console_ui: Main menu item that opens the controller interface.
desktop_console_ui_hint: Tooltip of the button that opens the controller interface.
desktop_menu_preferences: Main menu item that opens the settings window (GTK name).
desktop_save_failed: Notice. {reason} is an English error from the file system.
desktop_hostcard_save_failed: Notice. {reason} is an English error from the file system.
desktop_hostcard_remove_failed: Notice. {reason} is an English error from the file system.
desktop_hostcard_create_shortcut: Menu item that adds an app launcher entry for this host.
desktop_shortcut_added_body: Notice. {name} is the launcher entry's name (host, or host · preset).
desktop_shortcut_failed: Notice. {reason} is an English error from the file system.
desktop_hostcard_mgmt_port_default: The management port when none is set. {port} is the default port number.
desktop_hostcard_badge_pin: Badge on a found host: it pairs with a PIN.
desktop_hostcard_badge_open: Badge on a found host: it can be trusted on first use, without a PIN.
desktop_hostcard_badge_trusted: Badge on a saved host trusted on first use, without a PIN.
desktop_hostcard_pin_tiles: Submenu: pin a card (a shortcut to this host with one preset).
desktop_hostcard_pin_tile: Submenu item. {preset} is the preset's name.
desktop_hostcard_unpin_tile: Submenu item. {preset} is the preset's name.
desktop_speedtest_title_host: Speed test page title. {host} is the host's name; the dot is a separator.
desktop_speedtest_burst_body: Caption while measuring. {host} is the host's name.
desktop_speedtest_measured: Caption under the measured figure when there was no steady round.
desktop_speedtest_packets: Row value. {received} and {count} are whole numbers of packets.
desktop_speedtest_host_default: Current bitrate when the player left it to the host.
desktop_speedtest_live_goodput: Chart legend: the throughput while it is measured.
desktop_speedtest_legend_measured: Chart legend: the final measured throughput.
desktop_speedtest_save_failed: Notice. {reason} is an English error from the file system.
desktop_lib_failed_pin: Library error page. {host}: the host's name.
desktop_lib_failed_not_paired: Library error page. {host}: the host's name.
desktop_lib_failed_http: Library error page. {host}: the host's name. {code}: the HTTP status number.
desktop_lib_failed_unreachable: Library error page. {host}: the host's name.
desktop_lib_stale_unpaired: Banner over a cached game list when the host no longer accepts this device.
desktop_ring_editor_hint: Under the ring editor in the desktop apps.
desktop_ring_editor_open_hint: Under the quick actions editor. {keys} is a keyboard chord, {pad} a controller chord.
desktop_ring_reset_title: Alert title before the ring is reset.
desktop_ring_reset_body: Alert body before quick actions are reset.
desktop_ring_centre_tooltip: Tooltip on the ring editor's inert centre button.
desktop_shortcut_chord: Group title over the modifier toggles in the shortcut editor.
desktop_shortcut_capture: Toggle button: the next keys pressed fill the shortcut.
desktop_shortcut_capture_tooltip: Tooltip on the Press the chord button.
desktop_shortcuts_this_window: Section in the keyboard shortcuts window: the main window's keys.
desktop_shortcuts_stream_window: Section in the keyboard shortcuts window: the stream window's keys.
desktop_accel_show_hosts: Keyboard shortcut description in the shortcuts window.
desktop_accel_show_library: Keyboard shortcut description in the shortcuts window.
desktop_accel_search_library: Keyboard shortcut description in the shortcuts window.
desktop_accel_add_host: Keyboard shortcut description in the shortcuts window.
desktop_accel_reload: Keyboard shortcut description in the shortcuts window.
desktop_accel_preferences: Keyboard shortcut description: open the preferences window.
desktop_accel_shortcuts: Keyboard shortcut description: open this shortcuts window.
desktop_accel_fullscreen: Keyboard shortcut description: the main window's fullscreen.
desktop_controls_intro_title: Card title on the stream controls page.
desktop_controls_intro_body: Card body on the stream controls page.
desktop_bitrate_kbps_hint: Linux and Windows number box under Bitrate: its unit is Mbit/s, and 0 leaves the rate to the host.
desktop_fullscreen_hint: Linux, under the three-way Fullscreen picker.
desktop_fullscreen_exit_hint: {keys}: the shortcut that leaves fullscreen ("F11", "F11 or Alt+Enter"), from the client's shortcut table.
desktop_fullscreen_on_stream_exit_hint: Linux. {keys}: the keyboard shortcut ("F11"); {pad_keys}: the controller chord ("L1+R1+Start+Select").
desktop_adapter: Setting label: which graphics card decodes and shows the stream. Only on machines with more than one.
desktop_adapter_missing: Option of GPU: a saved card that is not present now. {name}: the card's name.
desktop_omarchy_menu: Linux (Omarchy desktop) switch. Omarchy is a product name.
desktop_omarchy_menu_hint: {keys}: the shortcut that opens the Omarchy menu ("Super+Space"). omarchy-menu.jsonc is a file name; keep it.
desktop_clear_art: Linux button: delete the cover images kept on disk.
desktop_clear_art_done: Toast after the cover cache was deleted.
desktop_clear_art_failed: Toast. {error}: the system's reason, in English.
desktop_preferences_title: Title of the Linux settings dialog.
desktop_player_overlay_actions_hint: Explainer for Quick actions on the desktop apps. keys is the keyboard chord (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+O), pad_keys the controller chord (Select+A), both from the shortcut table.
desktop_pad_steam_virtual: Subtitle of a detected controller that is Steam Input's virtual controller. Automatic is the option's name.
desktop_player_forward_pad_missing: Use controller option for a saved pad that is not connected now. name is the pad's name.
desktop_player_forward_pad_saved_name: Name shown for a saved pad whose name was not stored.
desktop_prefs_scope_editing_hint: Caption of the Editing row on Linux.
desktop_preset_this: Subtitle of the row holding the edited preset's Rename, Duplicate and Delete buttons.
desktop_preset_delete_body: First line of the delete confirmation. name is the preset's name.
desktop_preset_name_taken: Title of the name field while the typed name is taken.
desktop_about_system_libraries_body: Linux About dialog, legal section. Library and license names stay as written.
desktop_prefs_not_saved_title: Title of the error bar on the settings page when the settings file can't be written.
desktop_prefs_not_saved_body: Body of the error bar; the system's error text follows on its own.
desktop_player_overlay_actions_preset_hi: Second line of the Quick actions explainer on Windows.
desktop_pad_detected: Label over the list of controllers connected to this device.
desktop_preset_auto_name: Name a new preset gets before it is renamed; it is stored as the preset's name. n is the first free number.
desktop_preset_auto_name_bare: Fallback name for a new preset when no numbered name is free; stored as the name.
desktop_about_logs_hint: Under the button that opens the log folder, in About.
desktop_licenses_bundled_body: Windows licenses page. licenses\\ is a folder name: keep it.
desktop_licenses_section_bundled: Section heading on the Windows licenses page.
desktop_licenses_section_open_source: Section heading on the Windows licenses page.
desktop_notice_steam_touch_mouse: Pill once per stream in SteamOS Gaming Mode when Steam turns touches into mouse motion.
desktop_capture_release: Capture hint field. keys = the release shortcut, e.g. 'Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Q'.
desktop_capture_mouse_mode: Capture hint field. keys = the mouse-mode shortcut, e.g. 'Ctrl+Alt+Shift+M'.
desktop_capture_disconnect: Capture hint field. keys = the disconnect shortcut, e.g. 'Ctrl+Alt+Shift+D'.
desktop_capture_stats: Capture hint field. keys = the statistics shortcut, e.g. 'Ctrl+Alt+Shift+S'.
desktop_overlay_present: Detailed stats line on Linux and Windows: how frames reach the screen. mode = a technical present mode name, e.g. 'mailbox', 'fifo'. Fields follow after ' · '.
desktop_overlay_vrr_yes: Field of the 'present:' stats line: variable refresh measured as on.
desktop_overlay_vrr_no: Field of the 'present:' stats line: variable refresh measured as off.
desktop_overlay_smoothing: Field of the 'present:' stats line: the smoothness buffer is on.
desktop_overlay_scanout: Field of the 'present:' stats line: every frame went straight to the display (no compositing).
desktop_overlay_scanout_share: Field of the 'present:' stats line. share = percent of frames sent straight to the display, e.g. '73%'.
desktop_overlay_composited: Field of the 'present:' stats line: the compositor drew every frame.
desktop_stream_console_library: Windows: title of the status page while the controller interface runs in its own window with no host.
desktop_stream_console_library_host: Windows: title of the status page while the controller interface browses a host's library. host = the host's name.
desktop_stream_streaming: Windows: title of the status page while a stream runs in its own window, host unknown.
desktop_stream_streaming_to: Windows: title of the status page while a stream runs in its own window. host = the host's name.
desktop_stream_own_window: Windows: line under the status page's title.
desktop_stream_stats_waiting: Windows status page before the stream window reports its first second of stats.
desktop_stream_stats_off: Windows status page when the stats overlay is off. keys = the statistics shortcut, e.g. 'Ctrl+Alt+Shift+S'.
desktop_shortcut_quick_actions: Windows status page shortcut list field. keys = the shortcut, e.g. 'Ctrl+Alt+Shift+O'.
desktop_shortcut_release_input: Windows status page shortcut list field. keys = the shortcut, e.g. 'Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Q'.
desktop_shortcut_fullscreen: Windows status page shortcut list field. keys = the shortcut, e.g. 'F11'.
desktop_streaming_from_one: Linux banner over the host list while one stream runs. host = the host's name.
desktop_streaming_from_two: Linux banner while two streams run. first, second = host names.
desktop_streaming_from_many: Linux banner while three or more streams run. count = how many hosts.
desktop_disconnecting: Linux banner while the last streams close.
desktop_notice_amd_hdr_driver: Windows toast once per HDR stream on an old AMD driver. version = the driver's four-part version, e.g. '32.0.12033.0'.
desktop_hosts_field_mac_hint: Tooltip on the Wake-on-LAN MAC row of the add and edit host forms.
desktop_hosts_preset: Header of the preset picker in the Windows host editor, above the list of presets.
desktop_shortcut_description: Description stored in a Windows shortcut (.lnk) to a host, shown in its tooltip. label = the host's name.
